council-of-ministers-legal-terms.note: Catalogued as សទ្ទានុក្រមពាក្យច្បាប់ ផ្នែករដ្ឋប្បវេណី និងនីតិវិធីរដ្ឋប្បវេណី, Office of the Council of Ministers, 2007, in the Ministry of Education's Sala Digital library. Downloads as 3,289,452 bytes against 2,813,445 here — same 64 pages, so a different scan or compression of the same edition. The National Council of Khmer Language sat within the Office of the Council of Ministers at the time, so catalogues crediting either body are both right; `issuing_body` here follows the Sala Digital record.
